name: Colorado Watershed Restoration Grants
summary: Rolling grants in Colorado for planning, engineering and implementation of watershed work such as stream and floodplain restoration, revegetation and gully stabilisation, including post-wildfire protection projects. Non-profits and governments can apply.

calls.label: Rolling applications from February 2026

status.quote: The CWCB will accept applications on a rolling basis starting February 13, 2026, until the available funds are obligated.

opens.quote: The CWCB will accept applications on a rolling basis starting February 13, 2026, until the available funds are obligated.

calls.note: Open until the available funds are obligated

applicant_types.quote: Governmental entities - municipalities, districts, enterprises, counties, and State of Colorado agencies. Federal agencies are encouraged to work with local entities. (Local governments that do not participate in the National Flood Insurance Program will not be eligible for funding). Colorado's Tribal Governments Private entities - mutual ditch companies, non-profit corporations, and partnerships.

access.quote: All grant applications must be submitted via the CWCB Portal
